signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Ship one working feature or tool using AI coding tools, deployed and in use by the lab team.
Run your first user test on Mechanical Turk, UserTesting.com, or equivalent, and present what you learned.
Complete 15+ customer and stakeholder interviews focused on unmet needs, changing buying behaviors, and the future of enterprise learning.
Deliver a market and competitive assessment covering major shifts in AI, workforce development, skills, learning technology, and adjacent markets.
Present a prioritized opportunity map identifying 3–5 areas for further validation, supported by customer, market, and business evidence.
Build at least one prototype or concept to begin testing a high-potential opportunity with customers.
